name: inbox_reply_scanner
prompt:
The script output above has three JSON sections from the application tracker: SCAN (new replies from companies), FOLLOWUP (follow-up emails just sent) and STATS. Do not run anything yourself; only format them for WhatsApp.

1. NEW REPLIES: if "new_replies" is non-empty, list each with company, role, from address and the reply snippet. This is the important part; Vishal needs to know when a company responds.
2. FOLLOW-UPS: how many were sent and to whom (company and role), from the FOLLOWUP section.
3. STATS: total applications sent, total replies received, total follow-ups sent.

If "new_replies" is empty AND the FOLLOWUP "sent" count is 0: respond with exactly [SILENT].
If any section contains an "error" key: report that error in one line instead.
